episode_title: Collaboration Unscripted: What we are learning along the way
question: How does collaborative coaching differ from traditional team coaching?
transcript_excerpt: Collaborative coaching is different than typical team coaching because you are looking at teams of teams and different organizations. Understanding what words mean becomes so important because how we collaborate could be very different than how they collaborate, and we cannot just assume that we are going to get everyone in a room and they will figure it out and work together.

episode_title: Collaboration Unscripted: What we are learning along the way
question: Why is addressing small relational tensions important in team leadership?
transcript_excerpt: Small relational tensions deserve attention because they become big barriers if ignored. Leaders often avoid these little relational things, but those little relational things are often the things that get in the way of the overall success of a team and a project. If you would address that small thing 18 months ago, it could change where you are today versus letting it grow into a big mountain or big story.

episode_title: Collaboration Unscripted: What we are learning along the way
question: What role does vulnerability play in cross-organizational collaboration?
transcript_excerpt: Vulnerability is essential in collaboration because sometimes you have to admit that while we have done this thing a certain way forever, maybe it is not the best way going forward. There is a bit of giving up as well, or being willing and open to the possibility that there is another path forward. People often find it surprising when they realize they have permission to open up and share into the space.

episode_title: Collaboration Unscripted: What we are learning along the way
question: How can leaders refocus teams when ego and being right creates conflict?
transcript_excerpt: When we think about the outcome or the client or who we are serving or what we are trying to do, it can reground everybody in having a perspective of oh right, this is not about me being right or you being right. This is about how do we get to the place we need to. By regrounding in the why or the outcome we are looking for, it can help people step back and let go of some of the stuff they are hanging on to.

episode_title: Collaboration Unscripted: What we are learning along the way
question: What has been the most surprising outcome of collaborative coaching for teams?
transcript_excerpt: The most surprising thing was that people experience relief when there is space to speak openly. It is almost like there is a sigh of relief in the room, like oh I can finally get this off my chest. Teams also recognize that collaborative coaching opens up individual one-on-one coaching because people start to see their own patterns and realize there are things they can do individually to help as well.
